passages.name: Saori Desert Intro
passages.text:
A windswept desert stretches between two jagged mountain ridges. Saori approaches, studying you with a calm, assessing gaze.

SAORI: 'You are on your way to the market?'

choices.text: (T) Choice: 'Yes, I am looking for work, food, and a place to stay.'
choices.shared_beat: Saori's expression shifts â€” not toward the player, but past them. She glances over her shoulder, posture tightening. SAORI: 'You should take this.' She presses a strange device into your hands.
choices.playerLine: 'Yes, I am looking for work, food, and a place to stay.'

choices.text: (O) Choice: 'You are on your way somewhere too?'

choices.playerLine: 'You are on your way somewhere too?'

choices.text: (N) Choice: 'Well, anything is better than the middle of this desert.'

passages.name: Saori Device Departure
passages.text:
Saori steps back, already half-turned away.

SAORI: 'I must go.'

passages.name: Saori Already Spoke
passages.text:
Saori shakes her head, her expression unreadable.

SAORI: 'I have nothing more to say.'
